call.text: The authors state that the theoretical latency of 160 ms is achieved by the streaming, hierarchical architecture of Moshi, which is set by pretraining with an acoustic delay of 2 and finetuning with an acoustic delay of 1【MOSHI:5.3:c083】. The authors also note that this 160 ms theoretical latency is lower than the 230 ms average measured in natural conversations across 10 languages【MOSHI:1:c005】. In practice, the authors report a latency of 200 ms, which remains higher than the theoretical value but still comparable to natural conversation response times【MOSHI:abstract:c002】. The retrieved passages do not state how the practical latency directly compares numerically to the natural conversation latency.
